technology_name: DNA Tools for Timber Forensics (DNA Barcoding & Fingerprinting)
problem_solved: Rampant illegal timber extraction, species adulteration in supply chains, and the lack of conclusive, tamperproof evidence to trace confiscated wood back to its origin in judicial proceedings.
description: A pioneering forensic service utilizing a comprehensive DNA barcode reference database to verify species identity in wood and non-wood forest products. For localized theft cases, the facility employs advanced genome-wide DNA fingerprinting to genetically match confiscated logs directly to their exact source stumps, providing indisputable evidence for law enforcement and courts.
applications:
• Judicial forensics and evidence verification for law enforcement and forest departments

• Global trade compliance and certification auditing (e.g., FSC, EUTR)

• Supply chain transparency for commercial timber and furniture industries

• Environmental conservation and anti-poaching initiatives
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
